displayIdentity.body: Receiving the Spirit leads back to Abraham’s faith. Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified? So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
